narration.full_text: Welcome to our journey into trigonometry! In this section, we'll set the stage for understanding the fundamental relationships within triangles. Our main goal is to define and work with the six essential trigonometric ratios: sine, cosine, tangent, cosecant, secant, and cotangent. You'll learn how to calculate all these ratios for any given angle in a right-angled triangle. We'll also explore how to apply these ratios to solve real-world problems involving unknown side lengths and angles. Finally, we'll dive into understanding and verifying important trigonometric identities, which are crucial for more advanced topics. Let's get ready to unlock the power of angles and sides!
